test_title: PYST 1: SSC CGL 2024 - Quantitative Aptitude (Held On: 09 Sept, 2024 Shift 1)
subject: maths
question: Mohan borrows a sum of ₹4,22,092 at the rate of 20% per annum simple interest. At the end of the first year, he repays ₹21,679 towards return of principal amount borrowed. If Mohan clears all pending dues at the end of the second year, including interest payment that accrued during the first year, how much does he pay (in ₹) at the end of the second year?
solution:
[IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/ca81259519cadfb2d5350673c220e419e60378e9770ad26512fc8e826a8d93f1.png] __Shortcut Trick__

The final amount to be paid can be found by subtracting the future value of the part payment from the total future value of the original loan.

Total amount for 2 years (if no payment was made) = 422092 × (1 + 40%) = 422092 × 1.4 = ₹590928.8

Value of the 1st year repayment at the end of the 2nd year = 21679 × (1 + 20%) = 21679 × 1.2 = ₹26014.8

Remaining amount to be paid = 590928.8 − 26014.8 = ₹564914

**∴ The correct answer is ₹564914.**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/c76c13ba2d2ab46b47f8a931ae621dac081a0cb266b142dc23f58659fac4a466.png] **__Alternate Method__**

**Given:**

Principal (P) = ₹4,22,092

Rate (R) = 20% per annum simple interest

Principal repaid at the end of Year 1 = ₹21,679
